jis-university.description: JIS University is a private university of the JIS Group on Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, in the northern suburbs of Kolkata.
jis-university.about: The university was created by the JIS University Act, 2014 (West Bengal Act XXII of 2014) and began functioning in February 2015. It is run by the JIS Group and located at Agarpara. Its technical programmes carry AICTE approval.
jis-university.address: 81 Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, Kolkata, West Bengal 700109

maulana-abul-kalam-azad-university-of-te.description: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal is the state's technical university, with its main campus on NH-12 at Haringhata, Nadia.
maulana-abul-kalam-azad-university-of-te.about: The university was formerly the West Bengal University of Technology and took its present name on 6 April 2015. It is the affiliating university for most engineering colleges in West Bengal. Its main campus is at Haringhata, and it was awarded a NAAC B++ grade with a CGPA of 2.87 on its first assessment.
maulana-abul-kalam-azad-university-of-te.address: NH 12, Haringhata, PO Simhat, PS Haringhata, West Bengal 741249

narula-institute-of-technology.description: Narula Institute of Technology is an autonomous JIS Group engineering and management college on Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, near Kolkata.
narula-institute-of-technology.about: The institute was established in 2001 under the JIS Group Educational Initiatives. It received autonomous status on 29 July 2015 and is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. It is accredited by NAAC.
narula-institute-of-technology.address: 81 Nilgunj Road, Agarpara, Kolkata, West Bengal 700109
narula-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

regent-education-and-research-foundation.description: Regent Education and Research Foundation Group of Institutions is a private self-financed engineering campus at Bara Kanthalia near Barrackpore, North 24 Parganas.
regent-education-and-research-foundation.about: RERF is a private, self-financed, co-educational institution offering undergraduate and postgraduate programmes in engineering and other fields. Its campus is at Bara Kanthalia in the Titagarh police station area near Barrackpore. It received a NAAC B++ grade in its second cycle.
regent-education-and-research-foundation.address: Bara Kanthalia, Barrackpore, PO Sewli Telinipara, PS Titagarh, Kolkata, West Bengal 700121

sister-nivedita-university.description: Sister Nivedita University is a private university in New Town, Kolkata, established by a West Bengal state act in 2017.
sister-nivedita-university.about: The university was established by the Sister Nivedita University Act, 2017 (West Bengal Act XLIX of 2017). Its campus is in Action Area 1 of New Town, Kolkata. It offers B.Tech programmes through its School of Science and Technology, among other disciplines.
sister-nivedita-university.address: DG 1/2, New Town, Action Area 1, Kolkata, West Bengal 700156

techno-india-university-west-bengal.description: Techno India University, West Bengal is a private state university in Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata, set up under a 2012 act of the state legislature.
techno-india-university-west-bengal.about: The university was established by a West Bengal act of the state legislature in 2012 and is a full university, not a deemed one. UGC recognises it under Section 2(f) and lists it as competent to award degrees under Section 22. It offers undergraduate, postgraduate and doctoral programmes, including AICTE-approved engineering courses.
techno-india-university-west-bengal.address: EM-4, Sector V, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal 700091

techno-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.description: Techno Institute of Engineering and Management, also known as Techno India Banipur, is an engineering college on Banipur College Road in Habra, North 24 Parganas.
techno-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.about: The institute began in 2008 and belongs to the Techno India group. It is located at Banipur near Habra. It is part of the IIRS-ISRO outreach network and has served as a remote centre of IIT Bombay and IIT Kharagpur under the national mission on education.
techno-institute-of-engineering-and-mana.address: Banipur College Road, Habra, North 24 Parganas, West Bengal 743233

national-institute-of-technology-durgapu.description: NIT Durgapur is a National Institute of Technology on Mahatma Gandhi Avenue in Durgapur, originally founded as a Regional Engineering College in 1960.
national-institute-of-technology-durgapu.about: The institute was established in 1960 as Regional Engineering College, Durgapur, one of the first eight such colleges. It later became a National Institute of Technology under an Act of Parliament. It is located on Mahatma Gandhi Avenue in Durgapur, and B.Tech admission is through JEE Main and JoSAA.
national-institute-of-technology-durgapu.address: Mahatma Gandhi Avenue, Durgapur, West Bengal 713209

indian-institute-of-technology-kharagpur.description: IIT Kharagpur, founded in 1951, is the first Indian Institute of Technology and an Institute of National Importance in Paschim Medinipur, West Bengal.
indian-institute-of-technology-kharagpur.about: IIT Kharagpur was established in 1951 as India's first IIT. It is an Institute of National Importance offering programmes in science, engineering, technology, law, management and medicine. Its campus covers about 2,100 acres at Kharagpur. In NIRF 2025 it ranked 5th in engineering and 6th overall.
